summary.text: Ken Rahjes is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 110 since January 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ken Rahjes' professional experience includes working as a farmer and in agricultural broadcasting, in addition to serving in the Kansas House of Representatives.
Rahjes took office representing Kansas House District 110 on January 11, 2016.

In the 2025–2026 session he chaired the Agriculture Committee and was assigned to the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget Committee, the Appropriations Committee and the Special Claims Against the State Committee.

Ballotpedia also lists Rahjes as a 2026 candidate for Lieutenant Governor of Kansas, in which he lost in the Republican primary on August 4, 2026; he remains on the November 3, 2026 ballot for his House seat.
